sources.title: Seed 2.0 Official Launch
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The February 14 launch identifies Pro/Lite/Mini and Code, describes their roles and compares Pro performance with Seed1.8. It supplies no nominal total/active count or explicit relationship to a publicly sized base; performance succession is not parameter lineage.

sources.title: Seed2.0 product page
sources.evidence: Read October 27, 2026, including the current comparison tables and April Lite upgrade qualification. Exact Seed2.0 Pro (0215) columns contain benchmark scores, not total/activated counts. Pro/Lite/Mini are described as different sizes without numerical specifications.

sources.title: Seed2.0 Model Card: Towards Intelligence Frontier for Real-World Complexity
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the full June 30 official card from the same-day downloaded PDF text at /tmp/model130-reaudit/seed20_june.txt on October 27. Reviewed the introduction, Pro-specific tables and parameter/activation/base terminology throughout. Tables report pricing and capability results; parameter matches concern example tasks, not model size. No nominal count or sized-base mapping was found.

sources.title: Seed2.1 Model Card: Agentic Intelligence for Productivity
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the full 73-page later official card from the same-day PDF text at /tmp/model130-reaudit/seed21.txt on October 27. Checked exact Seed2.0 Pro comparison rows, introductory lineage and parameter/activated terms. The comparisons report benchmark scores, with no retrospective total or activated count or sized-base relationship for this target.

sources.title: Volcano Ark model list
sources.evidence: Current page fetched directly; read embedded MDContent after web rendering failed. Exact doubao-seed-2-0-pro-260215 rows specify 256k context, 224k input, 128k answer, deep thinking, text generation, visual understanding and tool calling. It is marked impending retirement; documentation does not prove endpoint operation.

sources.title: Doubao model service agreement
sources.evidence: Directly fetched embedded Markdown. Sections 1.2 and 2.2-2.3 grant limited nontransferable service use, retain model intellectual property and prohibit extracting model parameters; supports proprietary service classification.

sources.title: Official Seed2.0 API cookbook repository
sources.evidence: Reopened the repository and complete raw README October 27. It describes system-level optimization of foundation models and hosts API cookbooks/model card, without naming a publicly sized Pro base or reporting total/active parameters. Apache-2.0 licenses the cookbook, not hosted weights.

sources.title: Public Summary of Training Data Content for Seed 2.0 Pro
sources.evidence: Reopened all seven pages October 27, 2026. The July 31 summary identifies exact Seed2.0-Pro/Dola-Seed-2.0-Pro, gives model dependencies as N/A, and reports more than 10 trillion training tokens and more than 1 billion training images. These are data quantities, not parameter counts; no nominal model total or active count is supplied.

sources.title: DescribeBaasAIModels official API example: Doubao-Seed-2.0-pro
sources.evidence: Indexed first-party API example identifies exact Pro as the flagship general model for multimodal reasoning and long agent tasks. Its 260215 notes specify minimal/low/medium/high reasoning effort; minimal disables thinking. Direct rendered page returned no body.

sources.title: Seed2.0 original February Model Card
sources.evidence: Independently inspected the complete 78-page text freshly fetched October 27 at /tmp/model130-reaudit/seed20.txt. The Pro introduction and Tables 3, 8, 11 and 13 describe capabilities; no total/activated-parameter column or sized-base mapping appears. Parameter terminology refers to worked software/scientific tasks.

sources.title: Commercial comparison blog - unverified 320B/36B lead
sources.evidence: Fresh Chinese search indexed a 320B total/36B active Seed2.0 Pro claim. Both web open and direct curl returned HTTP500 on October 27, so the full article and its source chain were not inspected. Focused exact-count searches yielded no supporting developer specification; the indexed secondary assertion is not accepted as evidence.

sources.title: Seed2.0 release discussion - 1T+ numeric lead resolution
sources.evidence: Opened October 27 to resolve the 1T+ claim. A commenter guesses that Pro should exceed 1T, with no count-bearing primary source. The later attached model-card image was downloaded and visually inspected: it is Table3 of capability benchmarks, including LiveCodeBench, not parameter counts. No technical catalog value is based on the forum claim.

name.note: Official Pro variant; spacing normalized to the catalog style.

developer.note: ByteDance Seed develops the model; transparency disclosure identifies ByteDance Nexus AI as provider.

family.note: Seed2.0 belongs to the Seed foundation-model family.

release_date.note: Initial public launch. The 260215 API suffix and March EU placement do not replace this date.

open_weights.note: Official distribution is hosted products/API under proprietary terms; no Pro weight release found in the reviewed official materials.

license.note: Descriptive model/service license classification. Cookbook Apache-2.0 is not a Pro weight license.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 English/Chinese nominal-size and named-base searches plus original/later primary review found no supported Pro total or publicly sized base relationship. Transparency figures are training-data quantities; 320B and 1T+ leads lack verified developer support. Null reflects absent nominal evidence, not a demand for exact tensor counting.

active_parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 active/activated searches and separate inspection of original/current/later comparison tables found no Pro active count or activation convention. The 36B lead has no verified primary support; benchmark results and training-data quantities are not activated parameters. No sibling transfer or equality with total is inferred.

architecture.note: No production architecture disclosed for exact Pro in the reviewed reports or targeted first-party architecture/interpretability searches; dense/MoE and Transformer labels remain unsupported.

context_window.note: Provider publishes 256k; retain nominal decimal normalization, not an asserted exact binary token limit. Input and output caps are separate.

modalities.note: Pro has text/image/video understanding and text generation. No audio input claim is transferred from later Lite/Mini revisions.

reasoning.note: Exact Pro endpoint documents deep thinking and adjustable reasoning effort.

tool_call.note: Exact provider row supports tool calling; Pro agent evaluations corroborate tool use.

patch.notes: Provider context is advertised as 256k; 256000 is nominal decimal normalization. The original doubao-seed-2-0-pro-260215 endpoint is marked impending retirement in current Ark documentation. Nominal total and active counts remain undisclosed; no publicly sized base relationship is documented. Architecture remains undisclosed. The cookbook Apache-2.0 license does not license model weights.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retains null total and active counts after fresh original-source, transparency, full original/later-card and English/Chinese count/lineage checks. Resolved training-data figures and unsupported 320B/36B and 1T+ leads without promoting them to specifications. No nominal count or publicly sized base relationship was established. All unrelated assessments and existing context/lifecycle qualifications are preserved.
